newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa shares break technical barrier.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa shares break technical barrier.

text.p: Shares in German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG rose by more than three percent in pre-bourse trade on Tuesday as dealers said the stock broke through a point of technical resistance.
Lufthansa shares gained 76 pfennigs to 23.04 marks as dealers noted an increase in buying after its shares pushed above 22.40 marks. "That was a technical barrier for the shares," one trader said.

Such resistance points occur for financial securities because of the balance of demand and supply in the market. Once a security has breached a resistance point, it can often go on to make large gains.

Lufthansa shares last week fell heavily after the government announced plans for a law restricting foreign share ownership in the airline in a move aimed at allowing it to complete privatisation of the company.
Its shares have since recovered those losses and pushed ahead on the level at which they were trading before the new ownership proposals were published.
